title: Saltfork Paintball

services.name: Paintball GROUPS
services.desc: Celebrate your next birthday, bachelor party, or group outing with real paintball. Bigger hits, faster games, and all the adrenaline that made paintball famous. Recommended for teens, adults, and groups who want the full experience on our Western Town and outdoor fields Sign waivers, get gear issued, and split into teams. Our refs help balance groups so games stay fun and competitive. Several back-to-back missions across our fields - like Elimination, Capture the Flag, or atack and defend. Expect a mix of fast-paced, high-energy games before the break. Players grab food, drinks, or cake in your reserved party space - and take a moment to reload with more air and paint before heading back
